admin.importHint: Import expects a workbook with columns: Date (YYYY-MM-DD or D.M.YYYY), Time (HH:MM), Duration (min), Rink, Zone, Name, Email, Phone, and an optional Status (confirmed/cancelled). Handy for bulk-adding a recurring group booking — e.g. a kindergarten course's weekly ice time — download the template, fill in one row per date, and import it back.

admin.importScheduleHint: Columns: Rink, Date (YYYY-MM-DD or D.M.YYYY), Start Time (HH:MM), Duration (min). Rows sharing the same Rink+Date together replace that date's whole schedule.

admin.zoneQrDesc: One code per zone — scanning it opens the booking page filtered to just that zone's available times. Good for posting at each part of the rink.
admin.slotQrDesc: Pick an exact zone, date, and time to generate a one-tap registration code — scanning it opens the sign-up form directly for that slot, with nothing else to pick. Good for open-ice / walk-in sessions.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.notAuthorizedNotice: This tool is only for trainers and club staff.
tournaments.confirmDeleteTournament: Delete this tournament and all its matches?
tournaments.matchRowsHint: Fill in teams for whichever parts of the rink will be used — leave the rest blank.
tournaments.blocksIceLabel: Block this slot from public bookings
tournaments.blocksIceHint: If the tournament runs on the club's own ice, this blocks the chosen part from being booked via /book. Leave off if ice is arranged separately or the tournament is elsewhere.
tournaments.needAtLeastOneMatch: Fill in at least one match.
tournaments.duplicateTeamName: A team named "{{name}}" already exists in this tournament.
tournaments.needAtLeastTwoTeams: Add at least 2 teams to generate a schedule.
tournaments.previewHint: Preview — {{count}} matches. Adjust the break between rounds below.
tournaments.byeHint: With this many teams, {{count}} teams will get a bye in the first round (advancing automatically).
tournaments.knockoutPreviewHint: Bracket preview — {{rounds}} rounds. Advancement fills in automatically once a result is recorded.
tournaments.breaksHint: Break after each round of matches — edit a specific gap to override the default.
tournaments.noDraws: A knockout match can't end in a draw.
tournaments.needAtLeastFourTeams: Add at least 4 teams to split them into groups.
tournaments.groupAssignHint: Auto-assign uses the current order (snake distribution) — you can still move an individual team to a different group with its own dropdown.
tournaments.groupTooSmall: Group {{name}} has fewer than 2 teams — no matches will be played in it.
tournaments.groupsNotFinishedHint: Some group-stage matches don't have a result yet — the table below is a work in progress.
tournaments.finishedBadge: Finished — you can still correct the score
tournaments.publicScreenHint: Scanning this QR code opens the public tournament overview, which can be displayed e.g. on a cafe screen — it updates automatically as you record scores below.
tournaments.pointsForWinHint: A draw is always worth 1 point, a loss 0 — only the points for a win are configurable (usually 3).

schemaOptionDesc.roundRobin: Every team plays every other team — works well with fewer teams, final standings come from the running table.
schemaOptionDesc.knockout: A loss means elimination — teams advance through a seeded bracket to the final, with byes where needed.
schemaOptionDesc.groups: A group stage first (tables), then the top finishers from each group advance into a knockout bracket.

tournaments.favoriteTeamNoMatches: No matches for this team yet.
tournaments.tvScreenHint: A fixed, no-scroll dashboard layout meant for an unattended screen (a TV, a lobby display) — standings/bracket, live scores, and the next matches, sized to fill the whole screen automatically.
tournaments.matchImportHint: For a tournament played entirely at another venue (e.g. your team travels to someone else's tournament) — upload a spreadsheet with every match at once instead of adding them one by one below. A row with a Group (A, B, ...) creates/matches its teams and feeds the live standings table. Leave Group blank for a placement/play-off row scheduled before the outcome is known — write "A5" for "5th place in group A", "W:label" / "L:label" for the winner/loser of another row (give that row a Label, e.g. "SF1", so others can reference it) — the real team name fills in automatically once it's decided. Any other text in Team A/B is kept exactly as typed.
